C     ECPT( 3) = GRID POINT B                        NGRID(2)  INTEGER
C     ECPT( 4) = GRID POINT C                        NGRID(3)  INTEGER
C     ECPT( 5) = THETA = ANGLE OF MATERIAL           ANGLE     REAL
C     ECPT( 6) = MATERIAL ID                         MATID     INTEGER
C     ECPT( 7) = T                                   T         REAL
C     ECPT( 8) = NON-STRUCTURAL MASS                 FMU       REAL
C     ECPT( 9) = COORD. SYSTEM ID 1                  NECPT(9)  INTEGER
C     ECPT(10) = X1                                  X1        REAL
C     ECPT(11) = Y1                                  Y1        REAL
C     ECPT(12) = Z1                                  Z1        REAL
C     ECPT(13) = COORD. SYSTEM ID 2                  NECPT(13) INTEGER
C     ECPT(14) = X2                                  X2        REAL
C     ECPT(15) = Y2                                  Y2        REAL
C     ECPT(16) = Z2                                  Z2        REAL
C     ECPT(17) = COORD. SYSTEM ID 3                  NECPT(17) INTEGER
C     ECPT(18) = X3                                  X3        REAL
C     ECPT(19) = Y3                                  Y3        REAL
C     ECPT(20) = Z3                                  Z3        REAL
C     ECPT(21) = ELEMENT TEMPERATURE                 ELTEMP    REAL

C     E(1), E(3), E(5) WILL BE THE I-VECTOR
C     E(2), E(4), E(6) WILL BE THE J-VECTOR

      RETURN

      E(5) = E(5)/XSUBB

      E(4) = DBLE(Y3) - DBLE(Y1)
      E(6) = DBLE(Z3) - DBLE(Z1)

C

      E(8) = E(5)*E(2) - E(1)*E(6)
      E(9) = E(1)*E(4) - E(3)*E(2)

      IF (YSUBC .GT. 1.0D-06) GO TO 25
      CALL MESAGE (30,32,ECPT(1))

      NOGO = 1
      RETURN

C     NOW NORMALIZE K-VECTOR WITH YSUBC JUST FOUND
C
   25 E(7) = E(7)/YSUBC
      E(8) = E(8)/YSUBC
      E(9) = E(9)/YSUBC
C
C     J VECTOR = K CROSS I
C     STORE IN THE SPOT FOR J
C
      E(2) = E(5)*E(8) - E(3)*E(9)
      E(4) = E(1)*E(9) - E(5)*E(7)
      E(6) = E(3)*E(7) - E(1)*E(8)

C     AND JUST FOR COMPUTER EXACTNESS NORMALIZE J-VECTOR TO MAKE SURE.
C
      TEMP = DSQRT(E(2)**2 + E(4)**2 + E(6)**2)
      IF (TEMP .NE. 0.0D0) GO TO 26
      CALL MESAGE (30,26,ECPT(1))
C
C     SET FLAG FOR FATAL ERROR WHILE ALLOWING ERROR MESSAGES TO

C
      NOGO = 1
      RETURN

   26 CONTINUE

      E(4) = E(4)/TEMP
      E(6) = E(6)/TEMP

      REELMU = 1.0D0/XSUBB
      FLAMDA = 1.0D0/YSUBC
      DELTA  = XSUBC/XSUBB - 1.0D0

C         CSUBB = (3X2) STORED IN C( 7) THRU C(12) BY ROWS

      C(2)  =  0.0D0
      C(3)  =  0.0D0
      C(4)  =  FLAMDA*DELTA
      C(5)  =  C(4)
      C(6)  = -REELMU
      C(7)  =  REELMU
      C(8)  =  0.0D0
      C(9)  =  0.0D0
      C(10) = -FLAMDA*REELMU*XSUBC
      C(11) =  C(10)
      C(12) =  REELMU
      C(13) =  0.0D0
      C(14) =  0.0D0
      C(15) =  0.0D0
      C(16) =  FLAMDA
      C(17) =  FLAMDA
      C(18) =  0.0D0

      COSTH = COS(THETA)

C     BRANCH ON -HEAT- PROBLEM AT THIS POINT.

C

      G(2) = G12
      G(3) = G13
      G(4) = G12
      G(5) = G22
      G(6) = G23
      G(7) = G13
      G(8) = G23
      G(9) = G33

#include <Eigen/Dense>
#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <iomanip>

using namespace Eigen;

int main() {
    // Test case
    double x1=0.0, y1=0.0, z1=0.0;
    double x2=2.0, y2=0.0, z2=0.0;
    double x3=1.0, y3=1.5, z3=0.0;
    double E_mod = 2.1e11;
    double nu = 0.3;
    double t = 0.01;

    // Build E matrix (3x2): columns are i-vector and j-vector
    // i-vector = R_B - R_A
    Vector3d iv;
    iv << x2-x1, y2-y1, z2-z1;
    double XSUBB = iv.norm();
    iv /= XSUBB;

    // R_C - R_A
    Vector3d rc;
    rc << x3-x1, y3-y1, z3-z1;

    double XSUBC = iv.dot(rc);

    // k-vector = i cross rc
    Vector3d kv = iv.cross(rc);
    double YSUBC = kv.norm();
    kv /= YSUBC;

    // j-vector = k cross i
    Vector3d jv = kv.cross(iv);
    jv.normalize();

    // E matrix (3x2): col0 = i, col1 = j
    MatrixXd Emat(3,2);
    Emat.col(0) = iv;
    Emat.col(1) = jv;

    // Volume, mu, lambda, delta
    double VOL = XSUBB * YSUBC * t / 2.0;
    double REELMU = 1.0 / XSUBB;
    double FLAMDA = 1.0 / YSUBC;
    double DELTA = XSUBC / XSUBB - 1.0;

    // C matrix (3x6), partitioned into three 3x2 blocks
    MatrixXd C(3,6);
    // CSUBA (cols 0-1)
    C(0,0) = -REELMU;  C(0,1) = 0.0;
    C(1,0) = 0.0;      C(1,1) = FLAMDA*DELTA;
    C(2,0) = FLAMDA*DELTA; C(2,1) = -REELMU;
    // CSUBB (cols 2-3)
    C(0,2) = REELMU;   C(0,3) = 0.0;
    C(1,2) = 0.0;      C(1,3) = -FLAMDA*REELMU*XSUBC;
    C(2,2) = -FLAMDA*REELMU*XSUBC; C(2,3) = REELMU;
    // CSUBC (cols 4-5)
    C(0,4) = 0.0;      C(0,5) = 0.0;
    C(1,4) = 0.0;      C(1,5) = FLAMDA;
    C(2,4) = FLAMDA;   C(2,5) = 0.0;

    // G matrix (3x3) plane stress
    double G11 = E_mod/(1.0-nu*nu);
    double G12 = nu*G11;
    double G22 = G11;
    double G33 = E_mod/(2.0*(1.0+nu));
    Matrix3d G;
    G << G11, G12, 0.0,
         G12, G22, 0.0,
         0.0, 0.0, G33;

    // Common product: E*C_I^T * G  (3x3)
    // C_I is the 3x2 block for pivot point I=1 -> cols 0-1

    MatrixXd common = Emat * CI.transpose() * G; // (3x2)*(2x3)*(3x3) = 3x3
    common *= VOL;

    // No transformation (CSID=0), so common stays.

    // Now build KIJ (6x6)
    MatrixXd KIJ = MatrixXd::Zero(6,6);

    for (int I = 0; I < 3; I++) {
        // C_J block (3x2) for node J=I
        MatrixXd CJ = C.block(0, 3*I, 3, 2);
        // C_J^T * E^T  -> (2x3)*(3x2) = 2x2? No.
        // Fortran: GMMATD(C(6*I-5),3,2,0, E,3,2,1, ...) 
        // = C_J (3x2) * E^T (2x3) = 3x3
        MatrixXd CJEt = CJ * Emat.transpose(); // 3x3
        // No TJ transformation (CSID=0)
        // K_IJ block = common (3x3) * CJEt (3x3) = 3x3

        // Pivot is node 1 (index 0). KIJ(1..3, 1..3) etc.
        // Fortran stores KIJ(1..3) = row1 cols1-3, KIJ(7..9)=row2, KIJ(13..15)=row3
        // These go into pivot rows (1-3) and node J columns.
        int rowBase = 0; // pivot node 1 -> rows 0-2
        int colBase = 2*I; // node J columns
        KIJ.block(rowBase, colBase, 3, 3) = Kblock;
    }

    // Print as JSON
    std::cout << std::setprecision(6) << std::scientific;
    std::cout << "{\"stiffness_matrix\":[";
    for (int r = 0; r < 6; r++) {
        std::cout << "[";
        for (int c = 0; c < 6; c++) {
            std::cout << KIJ(r,c);
            if (c < 5) std::cout << ",";
        }
        std::cout << "]";
        if (r < 5) std::cout << ",";
    }
    std::cout << "]}" << std::endl;

    return 0;
}

- CSUBB = (3X2) stored in C(7) thru C(12) by rows
- CSUBC = (3X2) stored in C(13) thru C(18) by rows

So C(1)=row1col1, C(2)=row1col2, C(3)=row2col1, C(4)=row2col2, C(5)=row3col1, C(6)=row3col2.
